title: City Condo with Outdoor Pool Near Broadway
description:
Escape to our renovated, waterfront Nashville condo on the Cumberland River! This ground-floor retreat perfectly balances city fun and quiet relaxation. Just minutes from Germantown & Downtown's Broadway honky-tonks, it's your ideal Music City base. Enjoy a full kitchen, community pool, and free parking. Comfortably sleeps 4.

The space
Welcome to your cozy and convenient home base in Nashville! This bright and airy single-level condo is designed for comfort, accommodating up to four adults. The stylish, contemporary decor features touches of local character, like a Johnny Cash print and a Nashville map, to get you in the Music City spirit.

After a day of exploring you can unwind in a space that has everything you need for a relaxing stay:

• Kitchen: Fully stocked with plates, silverware, glasses, and basic pots and pans. Includes a Keurig 1-cup coffee maker for your morning brew and a toaster for easy breakfasts.
• Bathroom: We provide shampoo, conditioner, body wash, body lotion, and a hair dryer.
• Comforts of Home: Fresh linens, sheets, towels, an iron, and an ironing board are all available for your use.
• Entertainment: Enjoy free Wi-Fi and Smart TVs with access to your favorite streaming services.

Guest access
You will have private access to the entire one-bedroom condo. You are also welcome to enjoy the shared community amenities, including:

• Outdoor Pool (open seasonally typically April –September)
• Workout facility with exercise equipment
• On-site laundry facility
• Free on-site parking

Other things to note
• Local Guide: To help you explore like a local, all guests will receive an electronic guidebook with our favorite area recommendations.
• Smart TVs: The TVs are available for you to log into your personal streaming accounts (Netflix, Hulu, etc.). Cable television is not provided.
